budget: One design, no tuning/development selection; all six new seed clusters retained
primary_metric: Own final net profit, paired same seed/opponent/seat; seed is resampling unit

bootstrap.unit: Whole seed cluster, all opponents and seats; 3 contrasts; exploratory six clusters, no significance claim from mediator correlations

acceptance: 108 complete official games plus 4 reproducibility repeats; all 112 reexecuted with whole ordered state equality for 719 transitions; zero cash/revenue decomposition residual; focused official boundary checks; all source/default/history hashes preserved; no strategy promotion, no profitability requirement.
interpretation: No tuning or policy changes. New seeds used once. H-only omitted because previous ablation was inactive, not because harvest is universally useless. Six clusters exploratory.
failure_policy: No replacements/exclusions/retuning after results. Infrastructure failures documented; preserve partial evidence.

metrics.production: Ongoing TOMATO/STRAWBERRY eligible surviving plants at official daily refresh: potential 1 or 2 (watered and fertilized), admitted actual yield delta, clipped=potential-admitted. No invented terminal refresh; no cash valuation of clipped units. Include changed crop mix/opportunity counts.
metrics.scheduling: All actual per-unit effective actions grouped by operation/status; requested actions are not successes. Counts are workload descriptors, not optimality or independent causal profit. Include harvest units, discard and terminal unsold stock.
metrics.sales: Executed SELL quantities and cash per item; symmetric matched volume/price revenue decomposition where both quantities>0: volume=(Q1-Q0)*(P1+P0)/2, price=(P1-P0)*(Q1+Q0)/2. If either quantity=0 all revenue delta goes to entry/exit term. Exact identity checked; price term includes time/crop-market interactions, not pure demand effect.
metrics.cash: All executed market order cash deltas including seeds, product, hires, land and sales must reconcile final-initial money exactly. No marginal-per-action reward.
metrics.interpretation: Total matched policy effects plus descriptive mediator evidence. Cannot identify separate causal percentages for clipping vs scheduling vs sales without interventions; sales is downstream channel, not independent competing cause.
